summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the approval and consummation of a merger of shares of Bradesco Gestão de Saúde S.A. (BGS) into Bradsa S.A. (formerly Odontoprev S.A.), as part of consolidating healthcare businesses. The exchange ratio was previously established; BGS became a wholly-owned subsidiary, and Bradesco's stake in Bradsa rose to 91.35% (excluding withdrawal rights expiring May 7, 2026). A subsequent contribution of dental assets to Mediservice is noted. No price per share, premium, or advisor is disclosed. Watch for dissenter rights execution and regulatory clearance across subsidiaries.
